text: Pricing model: price = f(avg aesthetic rating) × size factor
description: Price = formula over width_cm, height_cm, area_m2, rating (avg). Formula in a tiny non-Turing-complete expression language (shared/expr.ts), editable with live preview on /admin, stored in D1 settings. Default max(80, round(600 * area_m2^0.8 * (rating / 5)^1.5, 10)); always rounded to whole euros.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Real (not relative) size lets the size factor be priced in cm² and compared across sessions
The average aesthetic rating is the rating input of the price formula
